EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for your interest in ASU
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
{!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for your interest in the Executive Master of Public Administration (EMPA) degree at Arizona State University. You can review our site for details about the program, including schedule, costs, and degree requirements. Please note the application deadline is March 15. If you have any questions, please contact Hector Zelaya, Director, Bob Ramsey Executive Education, at hector.zelaya@asu.edu or 602-496-1308. Thank you, Linda Linda Hess, M.Ed., CPM Operations Manager, Bob Ramsey Executive Education School of Public Affairs | Arizona State University 602-496-1305 | ramseyexecutive.asu.edu | Executive MPA Program | CPM Program
